## 2 · Training cost (Multivariate vs Per-channel)

`Per-channel` is the mean cost of one channel's model; `all channels` multiplies it by the channel count. Δ compares that total against Multivariate. The per-channel runs trained alongside other bands (8 or 12 trainings at a time; 316 runs logged before that was stamped), the multivariate ones one run at a time, so their times are contended and Δ is not a like-for-like cost; `frames/timing.csv` holds the uncontended estimate where the solo timing pass measured one (EMF, L336/O96). ‡ = a cell with a run that trained while another user's process was on the GPU (`specs/contention.yaml`): its time can only be too high, as sharing the card adds wall time, so it is ranked as logged. A ‡ time ranked ahead of another would stay ahead uncontended; one ranked behind may belong ahead. Its accuracy is unaffected. Only runs from the 2026-09-24 sweep on were monitored: no ‡ on an earlier cell means no record, not a GPU to itself.
